user_story: As a user, I want to retrieve a single task by its ID so that I can view its full details.

positive.title: Retrieve a task by a valid ID
steps: Ensure a task with ID '1234' exists in the system.
positive.expected_result: The response status is 200, and the response body contains the full details of the task with ID '1234'.

negative.title: Attempt to retrieve a task with a non-existing ID
steps: Send a GET request to '/tasks/5678', where '5678' is not a valid task ID in the system.
negative.expected_result: The response status is 404, and the response body contains an error message indicating that the task was not found.

edge.title: Retrieve a task with a boundary value ID
steps: Ensure a task with ID '1' exists in the system.
edge.expected_result: The response status is 200, and the response body contains the full details of the task with ID '1'.
